metadata.scenario_context: Tom has been promoted to a high-level executive position in his company, and his family is organizing a party to celebrate his professional accomplishment.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Japan strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Peru strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of buying carnations as a gift for Tom.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide the appropriate gift to bring to Tom promotion party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: David
shared_prefix.message: Hey David, have you thought about what gift we should get for Tom? I was thinking maybe some carnations would be nice. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Alex
shared_prefix.message: Hmm... carnations are nice, but maybe something a bit more personal would work better? Like a nice bottle of wine or a classy pen. Something he can remember this accomplishment by. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: David
shared_prefix.message: Well, I don't really see meaningful differences here. A gift is a gift, right? At the end of the day it's all the same. Plus, I think carnations can be nice if we add a personal touch, like a card. People figure it out. What matters is celebrating Tom's achievement, isn’t it?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.message: I mean, celebrating Tom's achievement is definitely important. But I believe that the gift can also reflect our respect for his hard work and success. A personal touch is good, but I think a more meaningful gift could leave a lasting impression. What about a nice watch instead?
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: David
turns.message: A watch is... nice, but it feels a bit extravagant. I think we should focus on something simple yet thoughtful. I’m more inclined toward the idea that the gesture is what counts here, not the price or extravagance. What about we keep the carnations and write something heartfelt? That's what really reflects our respect, I believe.
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.message: I get what you're saying about the gesture being important. A heartfelt message is definitely valuable. turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: David

turns.speaker: Alex

turns.speaker: Alex

I want that pride to reflect in the gifts I give too. A more substantial gift can show that respect and appreciation. I think we should consider that for Tom's celebration.
turns.label: Acceptance

positive.mediator_utterance: It sounds like both of you have thoughtful ideas for Tom's gift!
